ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_value IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 RET NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
 v_count number(5);
 BEGIN 
 
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT U.USER_ID
 
 FROM
 SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS SO, 
 SC_USERS U, 
 SC_GROUPS G,
 SC_USER_TYPES UT, 
 SC_USER_CLASS UC, 
 SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS SP,
 sc_user_groups UG,
 SD_PORTS
 WHERE
 UG.group_id = G.GROUP_ID
 AND U.USER_ID = UG.USER_ID
 AND U.USR_TYPE_CD = UT.USR_TYPE_CD
 AND U.CLASS_CD =UC.CLASS_CD
 AND UT.USR_TYPE_CD = UC.USR_TYPE_CD 
 AND U.USR_TYPE_CD =UC.USR_TYPE_CD
 AND SP.ROLE_ID IN 
 ( SELECT UR.ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID
 AND (UR.PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD OR :P_PORT_CD IS NULL)
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 UNION
 SELECT GR.ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES GR
 WHERE GR.GROUP_ID = UG.GROUP_ID
 AND GR.GR_ACTIVE = 1 )
AND SP.SYSOBJ_ID =SO.SYSOBJ_ID 
AND SP.SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
AND SP.RL_SYS_ACTIVE = 1
AND (U.PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD OR :P_PORT_CD IS NULL)
AND U.USER_ID LIKE NVL(:FROM_USER,'%')
AND U.USR_TYPE_CD LIKE NVL(:USER_TYPE,U.USR_TYPE_CD)
AND SD_PORTS.PORT_CD = U.PORT_CD
AND NVL(U.USR_LOCKED,0) <> 1); 

if v_count > 0 then
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:SCREEN_NAME);

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_PRINT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_print IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 P_PORT VARCHAR2(200);
 P_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 v_count number(5); 
BEGIN 
 
SELECT count(SC_USERS.USER_ID)
 into v_count
FROM SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS, SC_GROUPS,SC_USERS, SC_USER_TYPES, SC_USER_CLASS, SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS,sc_user_groups
WHERE
-- SC_USER_ROLES.ROLE_ID = SC_ROLES.ROLE_ID
--AND SC_USER_ROLES.USER_ID =SC_USERS.USER_ID
-- AND SC_USER_ROLES.PORT_CD = SC_USERS.PORT_CD
sc_user_groups.group_id = SC_GROUPS.GROUP_ID
AND SC_USERS.USR_TYPE_CD = SC_USER_TYPES.USR_TYPE_CD
AND SC_USERS.CLASS_CD =SC_USER_CLASS.CLASS_CD
AND SC_USER_TYPES.USR_TYPE_CD = SC_USER_CLASS.USR_TYPE_CD 
AND SC_USERS.USR_TYPE_CD =SC_USER_CLASS.USR_TYPE_CD
AND SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS.ROLE_ID IN ( SELECT UR.ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_USER_ROLES UR
 WHERE UR.USER_ID = SC_USERS.USER_ID
 AND UR.PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD
 AND UR.UR_ACTIVE = 1
 UNION
 SELECT GR.ROLE_ID
 FROM SC_GROUP_ROLES GR
 WHERE GR.GROUP_ID = SC_GROUPS.GROUP_ID
 AND GR.GR_ACTIVE = 1 )
AND SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS.SYSOBJ_ID =SC_SYSTEM_OBJECTS.SYSOBJ_ID 
AND SC_SYSOBJ_ROLE_PRIVS.SYS_TYPE IN (5,6) AND
 (:FROM_USER IS NULL OR SC_USERS.USER_ID =:FROM_USER)AND
 (:CLASS_CD IS NULL OR SC_USERS.CLASS_CD =:CLASS_CD)AND
 (:USER_TYPE IS NULL OR SC_USERS.USR_TYPE_CD =:USER_TYPE)
 AND (SC_USERS.PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD OR :P_PORT_CD IS NULL)
 AND NVL(SC_USERS.USR_LOCKED,0) <> 1; 
 -----****

 ---*** 
 IF v_count > 0 then 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:SCREEN_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PORT_CD);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_user_id',TEXT_PARAMETER,:FROM_USER);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CLASS_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_USER_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:USER_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL);
 end if; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
 END;
